 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Allianz Stadium hosts this Thursday, October 22, the Europa League clash between Juventus and Stade Rennais.
 Luciano Spalletti's side are looking to put their heavy 3-0 defeat to Lazio in Serie A behind them. Relying on Randal Kolo Muani's eye for goal and Nico González's ability to unlock defences, the Italians will look to live up to their billing as favourites. Meanwhile, French side Rennes arrive determined to spring a surprise with a potent attack led by Esteban Lepaul, who is fresh off an unprecedented hat-trick of penalties in Ligue 1. A high-intensity clash awaits in Turin.
